feature.label: General SEM PLS Three-Way Moderation Point Estimates

claim.supported_scope: One true three-way interaction in a recursive, single-group composite PLS model using two-stage construction, strong hierarchy, and fixed continuous or exact 0/1 binary probes.
claim.estimand: The jointly estimated coefficient for the sample-standardized X-by-W-by-Z score product, conditional X-by-W effects at the fixed Z probes, and simple slopes of X over the fixed W-by-Z probe grid.
assumptions: Exactly one three-way term is bound to an original focal relation and a parent two-way interaction.
The model contains all X, W and Z main effects and all X-by-W, X-by-Z and W-by-Z lower-order terms under strong hierarchy.
Continuous moderators use standardized minus-one, zero and plus-one probes; binary moderators are coded exactly zero and one.
exclusions: A second three-way term, fourth-order interactions, HOC interactions and three-way moderated mediation are excluded.
Bootstrap, permutation, Johnson-Neyman, groups, weights, clusters and non-listwise inputs are excluded from this point cell.
The observed-variable PROCESS workflow is separate and is not claimed by this latent-variable PLS cell.
warnings: This exact bounded cell is scoped Standard under quickpls_v253_streamlined_integration_v1; all exclusions and corrective fail-closed behavior remain in force.
SmartPLS documentation is used only as a terminology and observable-workflow benchmark; QuickPLS is independently implemented.

equations.expression: eta_y = b0 + bx*x + bw*w + bz*z + bxw*xw + bxz*xz + bwz*wz + bxwz*xwz + epsilon
effect_xw(z0) = bxw + bxwz*z0; slope_x(w0,z0) = bx + bxw*w0 + bxz*z0 + bxwz*w0*z0

references.citation: Dawson and Richter (2006), Probing Three-Way Interactions in Moderated Multiple Regression: Development and Application of a Slope Difference Test
QuickPLS 2.53 validation-only single-path and three-way compact reference matrix

simulations.design: Compact continuous-continuous and binary-continuous strong-hierarchy fixtures with known joint coefficients, fixed probes, reordered declarations, a missing lower-order term and singular product design.
simulations.seed_policy: Frozen deterministic score columns and scenario identities; no runtime network or external package dependency.
simulations.acceptance_rule: Every admitted point and probe agrees within 1e-10; missing hierarchy and singular designs are rejected without a completed result.

boundaries.case: A main score, pairwise product or three-way product is constant, nonfinite or makes the joint equation singular.
boundaries.expected_behavior: Fail with the affected term or equation identified and publish no completed result.

boundaries.case: The model requests another three-way term, missing hierarchy, HOC interaction, moderated mediation or unsupported binary coding.
boundaries.expected_behavior: Preserve the model and return one corrective blocked decision without silently simplifying it.

boundaries.case: Rows and eligible declarations are consistently reordered while ordered scientific operand identities are preserved.
boundaries.expected_behavior: Mapped coefficients and probe results remain scientifically equivalent.

boundaries.case: The same resident authority, data and compiled plan are executed repeatedly.
boundaries.expected_behavior: The scientific payload is identical apart from operational identifiers and timestamps.

boundaries.case: A term, hierarchy relation, coefficient, probe, method version, cell identity or visual-only flag is altered.
boundaries.expected_behavior: Strict validation rejects scientific tampering; presentation anchors never become scientific edges.

tamper_tests.expected_behavior: Reject a result whose three-way point cell differs from its compiled authority.
Reject a result relabelled with a two-way or bootstrap method version.
Reject a result whose resident dataset fingerprint differs.
Reject a changed archive member, presentation mapping or canonical attachment digest.
Reject duplicate keys, nonfinite values, missing hierarchy rows or incoherent probe identities.
Never reinterpret a historical visible interaction node as this method without a valid preserved interaction authority.

persistence.legacy_policy: Older interaction archives preserve their original scientific identities and coordinates; compatibility projection may show a visual anchor but never rewrites the archive.

applicability_blockers: HOC interaction or three-way moderated mediation
native.gui_cli_parity_rule: For the same resident authority, data and compiled plan, every surface reads the same canonical joint coefficients, probes and exact cell identity.
accessibility_rules: Context menu and M shortcut provide non-drag alternatives; anchors have descriptive accessible names.
Dash and marker shape supplement color, and every chart has an accessible source table.
